svg.title: Apple M5 Max compiled localization and selected-attention latency
svg.desc: Paired horizontal bars compare compiled compositional MLX (gray) with compiled custom Metal (blue) on Apple M5 Max with MLX 0.32.3. Panels a, b and c are localization at selection widths 128, 2048, 4096 for batch sizes 1, 8, 32, on one zero-based 0 to 240 microsecond scale. Metal is 1.10 to 1.21 times faster across the 9 geometries. Panel d is complete selected attention at batch 1 with width 128 and batch 8 with width 2048, on a separate zero-based 0 to 400 microsecond scale, with two logical shards on one device, fixed caches and 64-dimensional keys and values. Direct labels give each median to one decimal place. Bars are medians of three process-session medians and include dispatch, allocation, execution and synchronization; warmup and first-use compilation are excluded. No confidence intervals are implied, and these are not full-model results. Source: evidence/09-apple-mlx-consumer/summary.json and consumer-summary.json.
